name: prompt-deck
description: A bento widget beside the chat: saved prompts you tap to send, a flip card with tic-tac-toe and mini sudoku, and thirteen moving themes for the Claude app.

openOnStart.title: Open Prompt Deck when a session starts
openOnStart.description: Turn off to keep the pane closed until you type /prompts.

themes.title: Let Prompt Deck theme the app
themes.description: Turn off to keep Claude’s own look; the gallery then only previews.
